title: Playtest findings model and route-state ledger
body:
Part of: #165
Builds on: #216

## Summary
`#216` added the first repo-native playtest issue-promotion path, but routing is still too session-centric.

A single playtest session can contain multiple distinct actionable problems. To avoid issue spam, duplicate work, and brittle retry behavior, we need a normalized findings ledger between raw session artifacts and GitHub work items.

## Red
- The system stores session artifacts and can draft/promote an issue, but there is no first-class per-finding queue.
- We do not have stable fingerprints, route state, or issue/PR linkage per finding.
- Re-running analysis or promotion risks duplicate GitHub work.
- Human override decisions are not stored as first-class routing state.

## Green
Each actionable playtest finding has a stable identity, route status, audit trail, and GitHub linkage, so the orchestrator can decide `skip`, `update existing issue`, `create new issue`, `dispatch direct PR`, or `route to human` idempotently.

## Scope
- Add a per-finding data model, for example:
  - `playtest_findings`
  - optional `playtest_finding_links` / route history table if needed
- Normalize `analysis.result.issues[]` into finding records
- Store for each finding:
  - stable fingerprint/dedupe key
  - session id
  - timestamps
  - category/severity
  - artifact links
  - inferred component
  - route status
  - route reason / confidence
  - linked GitHub issue and/or PR
  - human override state
- Add Worker endpoints for:
  - listing unrouted findings
  - marking route decisions
  - attaching issue/PR refs
  - retrying / reopening a finding
  - storing manual overrides
- Make the route state idempotent across reruns

## Non-goals
- Full autonomous fixing logic
- Final GitHub review/approval logic

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] One analyzed session with `N` actionable findings produces `N` finding records
- [ ] Re-running analysis does not duplicate equivalent findings
- [ ] A finding can move through explicit route states such as `unrouted`, `skip`, `update_issue`, `new_issue`, `direct_pr`, `human_review`, `done`
- [ ] Each finding can link to a GitHub issue and/or PR with a persistent audit trail
- [ ] Manual override data is stored and readable by later orchestration runs
- [ ] Worker APIs return reviewer-openable context links, not local-only paths

## Suggested Lane
`server-api` with `qa-platform` follow-on consumers
